title: 4521-ESP-AGE-58-70-0013 R0 Level Gauge Specification
summary:
- Project: Solana, Job: 120006, Spec No.: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-70-0013
- Initialing required on cover sheet only; all other title block info on all pages
- Revisions identified in the body of the Specification
- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle available from Teyma USA & Abener Engineering and Construction Services General Partnership
- Confidentiality terms apply to information and know-how
- The level gauge is designed for HTF Expansion Tanks MV 205G thru M - Primary Level.
- It features a magnetic float with AISI 316 material and an accuracy of ± 2.5mm.
- Process conditions include nitrogen/ullage gas at the upper fluid and HTF liquid at the lower fluid.
- The gauge is to be delivered with specific locations to be released later.
- Warranty for materials is at least 1 year from plant start-up.
